title: Shapes the verb groups share
description: Referenced by the group schemas in this directory (M20).

done.description: What a verb prints when the instance answered with no object: what it did, and to what. `norite instance invite revoke` set the precedent of a document rather than nothing, so --json always gives a script something to parse.

action.description: What happened, in the audit log's vocabulary where there is one: guild.delete, member.remove, tag.apply.

target.description: The ids the verb acted on, keyed by what they are: guild_id, user_id, role_id.

user.description: Another account as the instance names it: a message's author, an invite's issuer (M20a).

id.description: A Snowflake ID, as a decimal string.

username.description: Exactly as sent, escaped where a terminal would act on it.

display_name.description: Exactly as sent, escaped where a terminal would act on it.
